scope: F1 read-only primary-source and offline synthetic byte-limit feasibility; no infrastructure provisioning, native destruction, real credentials/key material, owner qualification, F0 rerun or register edits
result: Transport is a viable provider-neutral extension surface for bounded value-free calls; complete custody contract remains infeasible to qualify on current artifacts. No concrete complete component/provider artifact was identified. This is not a proof of universal impossibility.

findings.capability: Exact arbitrary bytes and operation allowlist
findings.fact: Raw BindingRequest path copies Data into protobuf bytes without JSON recanonicalization. Generic InvokeBindingAsync<T> serializes JSON with configured options and must not define signed canonical bytes. Binding operation names are extensible, then checked against ListOperations; success proves no private authorization or custody primitive.

findings.capability: Complete 1000-target input and bounded original pages
findings.status: Default full-input gate fails; page transport envelope feasible
findings.fact: Daprd default MaxRequestBodySize is 4,194,304 bytes; its API gRPC server applies this to both send and receive messages. --max-body-size is a supported API server option, not a pluggable-client receive override. grpc-go pluggable client default response limit is separately 4 MiB and output connector specifies no override. SDK grpc-dotnet receive default is 4 MiB. Even with short tenant and only object/alias at 2048 bytes, the 1000 identity vector is 4,284,001 bytes. A 1000 identity vector with just tenant/object/alias at existing 2048-byte limits already uses 6,316,001 ASCII canonical bytes excluding proof/envelope/protobuf; all seven text fields at validator maxima use 14,487,001. These are lower-bound witnesses, not the complete worst escaped-field request. Do not silently split targets, shrink fields, raise limits, compress, or infer a deployment override. A <=256 KiB original page inside <=1 MiB encoded frame leaves transport headroom but still needs exact authorization/identity/digest/reassembly verification.

findings.capability: Private operation authorization and anchored phases
findings.status: Not supplied by Dapr; contract implementation required
findings.fact: OutputBinding.Invoke has data, metadata and operation only. x-component-instance is a multiplexing label, not authenticated end-user or exact-operation authority. UDS uses insecure gRPC credentials, relying on socket isolation. SDK API token authenticates access to sidecar; component scopes/app ID alone do not authorize custody. Exact signed private control proof, independently current trust/revocation and four distinct admit/record/recover/verify implementations remain required. Verify/lookup cannot mutate or imply admission.

findings.status: Transport behavior verified; durable semantics absent
findings.fact: SendToOutputBinding uses ComponentOutboundPolicy. Without matching configured/default retry, def.r is nil and policy runs operation once. An outbound retry policy repeats Invoke; no exactly-once authority is created. SDK caller token reaches gRPC CallOptions and output pluggable Invoke forwards request context. Policy timeout can return while goroutine/native I/O completes later; binding runner installs no response disposer. Cancellation/deadline never establishes absence, revoked key delivery, native completion, erasure, or rollback. Persist NativeIntent SendCommitted before native send; uncertain sends are not replayed after restart. Duplicates resolve original request/status; lost-result lookup/read pages remain authenticated read-only and cannot release cached key bytes.

findings.capability: UDS discovery, reflection, restart and re-registration
findings.status: Protocol/discovery source verified; component recovery not implemented
findings.fact: Pinned bindings.proto imports common.proto. Discovery enumerates socket files under DAPR_COMPONENTS_SOCKETS_FOLDER (default /tmp/dapr-components-sockets), uses gRPC reflection v1alpha, removes filename extension for implementation name, and registers bindings.<socket-stem>. Component logical metadata.name is independent. Init then ListOperations runs when output component is initialized; registration/operation discovery is no capability attestation. Component ready/socket must precede daprd startup. Generic reconnect does not establish durable custody state, re-Init identity continuity, current authority, old-I/O drain or changed-profile rejection. Require external surviving authority and same enrollment/store/incarnation/trust/artifact profile across re-init; changed profiles fail closed. Protect socket mount/ACL from app container.

findings.capability: Ephemeral owned-key delivery and buffer closure
findings.status: Current SDK/sidecar path does not establish complete closure
findings.fact: SDK raw binding request copies caller memory; ByteString CopyFrom(span) allocates independent bytes.ToArray(). Generic JSON path adds SerializeToUtf8Bytes plus ByteString copy. Raw response retains protobuf ReadOnlyMemory without disposal/zero API; typed deserialization creates more state. grpc-go Free returns byte buffers to pool; default pool clears on a subsequent Get, not Put. Method return/cancel/connection close is no zeroing receipt. This is a concrete lifetime gap even with synthetic data and successful transport; no real memory scan or physical-key experiment was performed.
findings.missingPrimitive: Authenticated per-delivery quiescence and disposal/zeroing acknowledgement across all SDK/protobuf/sidecar/component/UDS/kernel/provider-transport copies, or independently accepted exact-incarnation process/host isolation and termination proof. No such primitive exists in OutputBinding protocol.

accountingStrategy.inventory: Before release, independently durable KeyUseLeaseId/DeliveryAttemptId and NativeIntent IDs bind original root/request, exact recipient process, producer, sidecar, component and transport incarnations; ledger every actual attempt and copied holder.
hops: caller owned array and serializer buffers
component decoded arrays/native provider-client transport buffers
UDS/kernel socket queues and TLS buffers where used
recipient process owned array and downstream consumers
accountingStrategy.completion: Record bounded per-hop owner/artifact/profile/incarnation, bytes class (no raw key in ledger), copy/delivery admission and evidence references. Zero owned mutable buffers and retain completion evidence. For opaque framework/runtime buffers, provide tested instrumented zeroing+quiescence implementation or independently accepted isolation/termination proof covering every exact process and host copy; GC, timeout, lease expiry, credential revocation and restart alone do not count.
accountingStrategy.faultChecks: Separately authorized F2/F3 must fault duplicate/delayed sends, loss after SendCommitted, cancellation before/after release, sidecar/component restart and re-registration. Unknown holders remain open and block arm/publication; no raw-key result cache or page path.
accountingStrategy.diagnostics: Disable body/key logging, content traces, core/memory capture/swap/hibernation and memory snapshots in exact accepted artifact/deployment profile; settings alone do not prove deletion.

findings.fact: Dapr runtime go.mod pins components-contrib v1.18.0. Retained complete untruncated upstream tree at that commit contains no custody-named implementation. Generic secret store has retrieval operations; cryptography interface has key/crypto operations. Neither supplies complete original current-authority/admission/manifest physical-cut/copy/holder/restore semantics. Proposed bindings.hexalithcustody is a new semantic component contract without implementation/artifact, external authority/provider proof, or end-to-end Dapr qualification. This limited inventory/source inspection does not prove no provider could ever implement it.

separatelyAuthorizedF2F3Prerequisites: Implemented immutable, independently governed custody component/provider artifact behind Dapr, authenticated enrolled authority/store/profile/trust and independent observer; no application-native provider bypass.

Approved supported complete-input transport profile demonstrated for every legal field/escape/full-proof bound on SDK->sidecar->component; component request server configured explicitly. Current default fails. No target chunking.

Durable linearizable current head; complete original request/response paging and permanent original indexes; exact admit/record/recover/verify permissions; NativeIntent at-most-once send and restart recovery.

Implement and accept per-delivery buffer/holder completion or exact-incarnation isolation/termination assurance for every hop. Preserve original root and ephemeral owned-key semantics; no raw-key persistence/replay.

Accepted exact resource/monetary ceiling, independently retained public/original evidence and outside-app restore/failure-domain authority; separately approved synthetic two-tenant native schedule and provider destruction wait.

Run actual Dapr/component/provider faults and independent physical/all-copy/survivor/restore proofs only after prerequisites and authorization exist. Real Live remains explicitly Blocked; no Available claim or register mutation.
